subject: social
title: People and Places
about: How weather and land change what people wear, eat and build, and how people change the land with roads, bridges, dams and pollution. NC 1.G.2.1 and 1.G.2.2.
tip: Look out the window and ask: what did people build here, and what did the weather make us wear today?

cards.q: What do you wear on a snowy day?
cards.note: Cold weather makes people put on warm clothes.

cards.q: What do you wear on a hot sunny day?
cards.note: Hot weather makes people wear light, cool clothes.

cards.q: What do you carry on a rainy day?
cards.note: An umbrella keeps the rain off your head.

cards.q: What can people who live by the ocean catch to eat?
cards.note: People who live near the water often fish for food.

cards.q: What do people often do on flat land with good soil?
cards.note: Flat land with good soil is just right for farms.

cards.q: What can people do near snowy mountains?
cards.note: Snowy hills are good for skiing and sledding.

cards.q: What do crops on a farm need from the clouds?
cards.note: Rain from the clouds gives plants the water they need to grow.

cards.q: What do people build so cars can cross a river?
cards.note: A bridge goes over the water so cars can get across.

cards.q: What do we call a big spinning storm from the ocean that brings wind and rain to the coast?
cards.note: Families get ready and stay inside until the storm passes.

cards.q: In a dry desert, what do people need to bring with them?
cards.note: A desert gets very little rain, so people carry water with them.

cards.q: What do we call making the air, land or water dirty?
cards.note: Pollution is dirt and smoke that people put into nature.

cards.q: What do we call a big wall built to hold back river water?
cards.note: A dam holds back a river and makes a lake behind it.

cards.q: What do people build to drive on across the land?
cards.note: People build roads so cars and trucks can travel from place to place.

cards.q: When people cut down a forest to build houses, what happens to the land?
cards.note: People change the land when they build on it.

cards.q: What can people plant to clean the air and give shade?
cards.note: Trees clean the air, give shade and make homes for animals.

cards.q: What can smoke from cars and factories do to the air?
cards.note: Smoke is one kind of air pollution.
